text:
maria: Heads-up — quota dashboard started showing NaN/empty profiles after last telemetry schema deploy. Looks like older events don't have quota_profile_id. Anyone got a plan for safe rollout/backfill?

ravi: Yep seeing the same for a few tenants. UI assumes quota_profile_id present now so aggregate is blowing up.

alex: Short options: derive-on-read, run a full backfill in CH, or dual-write and shadow index then backfill. Each has tradeoffs.

jamie: Derive-on-read = safe but slow queries. Backfill on ClickHouse could be heavy. Dual-write + incremental backfill per-tenant seems reasonable.

maria: Current console metrics rely on a materialized view that joins telemetry -> quota_profiles. If we backfill we need to refresh that MV or rebuild index.

ravi: Proposed playbook: 1) add nullable column quota_profile_id in CH and Postgres ingest schema, 2) enable dual-write for new events (immediate), 3) run staged backfill windows per-tenant with throttling, 4) add read fallback compute when quota_profile_id is NULL, 5) flip console to prefer persisted field, 6) deprecate fallback after 30 days.

alex: Important: quota service must implement fallback compute to avoid gaps during migration. Also add circuit breakers so queries don't timeout.

liz: Backfill on CH can thrash resources. We need rate limits and a coordinator that yields. Also consider doing small batches via INSERT SELECT with LIMIT.

jamie: SQL snippets to bootstrap (rough):
```
ALTER TABLE telemetry ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS quota_profile_id Nullable(String);
-- incremental backfill snippet
INSERT INTO telemetry (event_ts, route, quota_profile_id, ...)
SELECT event_ts, route, compute_quota_profile(route, attributes), ...
FROM telemetry WHERE quota_profile_id IS NULL AND event_ts >= toDateTime('2026-03-01') LIMIT 1000000;
```

maria: Also need to extend retention for affected tenants so events aren't expired before backfill. Ravi, can you check retention windows?

ravi: Will check. Might need temporary extend from 7d -> 14d for high-usage tenants. I'll list affected tenant IDs.

infra-bot: migration-job scheduled: id=iqm-2026-03-21T03:00Z owner=eng-platform estimated-duration=48h throttled=true

maria: Who can draft the runbook + rollback? Need steps, health checks, and a clear fail-open path for the console.

jamie: I'll draft runbook. For health checks: missing_quota_profile_count, backfill_progress_percent, query_latency_p50/p95, and a feature-flag gate.

alex: Feature flag name suggestion: console.quota.migration.v1. Add metric to warn if missing_count > 1000 after migration start. :thumbsup:

liz: Also log backfill rate and CH CPU. We'll abort if CPU > 70% for >5m.

ravi: One more: ensure model that computes quota_profile is stable. If we change compute_quota_profile logic post-backfill, we'll get inconsistent historical attribution. Maybe store computation version as quota_profile_v.

maria: Good call — version the computation and include quota_profile_v in backfill. We'll include that in schema change.

alex: Ok I'll add the health checks + FF + monitoring dashboards.

maria: Thanks. Meeting in 30 to finalize owners. I'll own coordination and publish runbook link after jamie's draft.
